reason: The hypothesis combines the known concepts of lattice distortion and coherent nanoprecipitates from separate alloy systems (e.g., P2/P3/P7 for lattice distortion in HfTaTiVZr/TaTiVWZr, P18/P38 for coherent nanoprecipitates in a different W-based HEA, P16/P17/P13 for coherent interfaces in W-ZrC) and applies them specifically to the WTaTiVZr alloy to explain its plastic strain and toughness, a synthesis not stated in any single passage. It also proposes a controlled comparison with pure tungsten to isolate these mechanisms, which goes beyond the individual studies.
